sisi.depan: A wide, single-pane horizontal window with a chunky, dark composite frame shows a view of an adjacent building's weathered wall, set above a low, floating console with integrated soft-glowing data ports.
sisi.kanan: The main entrance is a sliding panel of smooth, cream-colored polymer molded into a wide woven pattern, next to a wall-mounted rectangular light panel with a geometric cutout.
sisi.belakang: A plain wall section of faded blue paint has a tall, slender floor lamp with a cylindrical shade standing in one corner.
sisi.kiri: An open, arch-less doorway with rounded edges leads deeper into the house, beside a large, hanging wall panel of synthetic fabric printed with a faded, abstract floral batik motif.

tengah: A long, chunky couch with rounded arms and faded green fabric upholstery featuring several smooth, darker green patches faces forward, placed before a low, circular coffee table made of a dark, polished composite material.
atas: The flat, off-white ceiling has a large, central, recessed circular light fixture emitting a diffuse, warm glow.
